decisive_items: 6.9 × 5.5 × 6.1 cm lobulated mass centered at the left cerebellopontine angle
extension into the left infratemporal fossa via the foramen ovale
response.rationale: The location and lobulated appearance of the mass are consistent with schwannoma, and the extension into the infratemporal fossa via the foramen ovale is a characteristic feature of schwannoma.

rejected.why: While chordoma can cause bone erosion and remodeling, the location and appearance of the mass are more consistent with schwannoma.
Meningioma can cause calcifications and smooth bone remodeling, but the location and appearance of the mass are more consistent with schwannoma.
